title: PIRanNN: Random-Feature Pricing and Calibration under Jump-Diffusion and Stochastic-Volatility Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.19792v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a random-feature method for pricing and calibrating European options under jump-diffusion (Merton, Kou) and stochastic-volatility (Heston, SABR) models. The network has one hidden layer with a probit activation and fixed random inner weights, so fitting it to the pricing equation, the payoff and the boundary conditions is a single regularised least-squares problem, with no iterative training. For Merton and Kou the jump integral of each feature is explicit, so no quadrature is needed. One factorisation of the least-squares matrix gives the price at every state and time, its Greeks, and the exact derivatives of the prices with respect to the model parameters for gradient-based calibration. For the jump models, subtracting the Black-Scholes price removes the payoff kink and reduces the pricing error by about two orders of magnitude. translated_title: PIRanNN：跳跃扩散与随机波动率模型下的随机特征定价与校准
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一种随机特征方法，用于在跳跃扩散模型（Merton、Kou模型）和随机波动率模型（Heston、SABR模型）下对欧式期权进行定价与校准。该网络仅含一个隐藏层，采用probit激活函数和固定的随机内层权重，因此将其拟合至定价方程、收益函数及边界条件等价于求解一个单一的正则化最小二乘问题，无需迭代训练。对于Merton和Kou模型，每个特征的跳跃积分均有显式表达式，因而无需数值求积。只需对最小二乘矩阵进行一次分解，即可同时得到所有状态和时间下的期权价格、相应的Greeks敏感度指标，以及价格对模型参数的精确导数，用于基于梯度的校准。对于跳跃扩散模型，通过减去Black-Scholes价格可消除收益函数的尖角，并将定价误差降低约两个数量级。该方法的精度与标准的Crank-Nicolson有限差分格式大致相当……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PIRanNN方法，利用带固定随机权重和probit激活的单隐层网络，将跳跃扩散与随机波动率模型下的欧式期权定价与校准转化为一次正则化最小二乘问题，无需迭代训练即可通过一次矩阵分解同时获得价格、Greeks及校准所需梯度，其精度媲美Crank-Nicolson有限差分方法。
